"i). Issue a writ of certiorari or any other appropriate writ order or direction,
quashing Exhibit P3 notice issued by the 2nd respondent.
ii) Issue a writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ order or direction,
directing the respondents to allow the petitioner to run the hotel business peacefully.
iii).

Grant such other and further relief as are deemed just and necessary in the facts and circumstances of the case including the costs of this proceedings; as also the following:
iv).
Petitioner may be permitted to dispense with the filing of transaction of the vernacular documents."

(SIC)
2.
The petitioner is the proprietor of Raj Hotel situated at TB Junction, Punalur is the submission.
He is conducting the hotel business in the building bearing Door No.PMC 13/492, 13/492(2) and 13/492(4) of Punalur Municipality.
Petitioner is running the hotel, after obtaining necessary license from the 1st respondent Municipality is 2026:KER:15172 the submission.
License period is from 01.04.2022 to 31.03.2027 is the further submission.
The petitioner has also obtained license under the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 (FSS) from the Commissionarate of Food Safety and the same is valid upto 17.07.2027 is the further submission.
It is submitted that the petitioner is running the hotel business complying all the conditions as per the licenses issued by the respective authorities.

Now the 2 nd respondent issued Ext.P3 notice stating that the license of the petitioner's hotel has been obtained in the building bearing Door Nos.13/492, 13/492(2) and 13/492(4) and out of the same, Door No.13/492(4) is part of the supermarket conducted by the 4th respondent and hence the license is to be cancelled.
The 3rd respondent is the brother of the petitioner and the 4th respondent is the son of the 3rd respondent.
Respondent Nos.3 and 4 are not in good terms with the petitioner is the further submission.
Moreover, it is also submitted that Ext.P3 is an order passed without giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner.
Hence, 2026:KER:15172 this writ petition is filed.
3. Heard, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the Standing Counsel for the Municipality.

I also heard the counsel appearing for respondent Nos.3 and 4.
4.
This Court perused Ext.P3 notice dated 04.02.2025 issued by the Clean City Manager, Punalur Municipality.
A perusal of the same would not show that it is an order passed after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner.
The counsel appearing for the party respondents submitted that it is an appealable order.
This writ petition is pending before this Court for the last one year and an interim order is also passed.

At this stage, I don't want to relegate the petitioner to file an appeal,
especially when the petitioner has got a case that Ext.P3 order is passed without giving an opportunity of hearing him.

5. Therefore, without considering the case on merit, Ext.P3 can be set aside, with a direction to the 2026:KER:15172 Municipality to reconsider the matter, after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and respondent Nos.3 and 4.

All the contentions of the petitioner and the respondent A. M. Abraham vs Punalur Municipality on 18 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181148891/
3 Nos.3 and 4 are left open.

Therefore, this Writ Petition is disposed of with the following directions:
1. Exhibit P3 is set aside.
2. The 2nd respondent or the authorised officer of the Municipality will reconsider the matter, after giving sufficient opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and respondent Nos.3 and 4, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
3. Till then, the status quo as on today will continue.
